en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘O brother of Jau’f! The Emān is superior than the Islām, and that ‘الْيَقِينَ’ the conviction is superior than the Emān, and there is nothing more cherished than ‘الْيَقِينَ’ the conviction’.
en.sarwar: 1. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al- Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.)
once said, ‘O brother from Ju’f (name of his tribe) belief is superior to Islam and certainty is superior to belief. Nothing there is dearer than certainty.”
